name: UMA-side operations: whitelisted proposing, dispute bounties, staking and DVM voting
one_line: Propose answers to Polymarket's UMA questions for $0.6-$5 each (339-address whitelist, $500-$750 posted per proposal), dispute wrong ones for half the bond, or stake UMA for ~21%/yr in UMA; ~$29k/day of proposer rewards over a seven-day on-chain census but two addresses take ~53%; the real asset is the proposal feed.
maturity: Established as a mechanism and income for ~10 addresses (weekly census: ranks 1-10 earn $0.5k-$10k/day); Emerging for a newcomer (whitelist gate, first-correct race, median earner ~$20-30/day); disputing negligible; staking price-risk dominated
requires_ai: optional; rules reading and dispute triage on the long tail
edge: Venue-paid reward to the first correct proposer; emission yield for reliable voters
capital: $1k-$10k; capital caps concurrent $500-$750 bonds, not income
build_time: 1-2 weeks on a resolution-sniping stack, 4-6 from scratch, plus 1-2 months qualifying
opportunity_size: ~$29k/day proposer rewards (7-day census; $19-25k weekdays, $42-48k weekend days), ~$13-14k/day contestable; disputes 0.05%; staking 4.1M UMA/yr
expected_results: ranks 11-20 earn $150-$400/day, 40th ~$35/day, median ~$20-30/day (on-chain); newcomer guess $0 for 1-2 months then $10-$60/day; staking ~21%/yr in UMA
competition: 94 active proposers; top-2 ~53%, top-10 ~80% of rewards
flag: none proposing/disputing truthfully; grey voting with positions; delay-disputes prohibited
validate: one-month replay of MOOV2 logs vs own answers: >=99.8% accuracy and first-correct share worth >=$100/day
top_risk: One lost $500-$750 bond erases hundreds of $0.8 wins
solo_fit_reason: Cheap to build on an existing resolution-sniping stack and the proposal feed is genuinely useful, but the whitelist gate (nothing earned for 1-2 months), the race against ~90 bots led by two probable venue bots, and the 99.8% accuracy bar cap a newcomer at tens of dollars a day; staking is a token bet.
speed_class: latency-sensitive: first correct proposal per Polygon block wins the reward
results_1k: marginal; $130-$580/month net (guess), two open $500 bonds, $0 until whitelisted
results_10k: $350-$2,700/month net (guess; top of range = today's rank-20 tier); capital not binding
min_capital: ~$2-3k USDC.e: three $750 bonds plus one loss
capacity_ceiling: ~$20-30k float; then the ~$13-14k/day contestable flow and race share
services: UMA docs, whitelist contract, vote dapp, Discord
changes_made: Replaced the packs' 'negligible' framing with a settle-derived reward flow and its concentration; states plainly that the critic's per-proposal arithmetic is right and that volume, not reward size, makes it a business for ~10 addresses.
Documented on-chain bond ($250/$500 + $250 final fee), USDC.e currency, custom liveness 600-7,200 s, live whitelist 339, emission 0.13 UMA/s and 19.5M staked.
Flagged docs staleness ('anyone can propose', '$750 pUSD') and the new Data API extended_review state.

Cite-check pass (2026-09-28 16:20-16:55 UTC): independent seven-day on-chain census (blocks 94,201,937-94,605,849, ~1.16M logs, dRPC + Tenderly) reproduced the mechanics exactly but cut the reward pace from the writer's $39.6k/day (a 17-hour window straddling the Sunday-night settlement wave) to a ~$29k/day weekly average ($19-25k weekdays, $42-48k weekend days, ~$10.5M/yr); top-2 share 56% -> ~53%, top-5 ~69%, top-10 ~80%; earner ladder restated (ranks 3-5 $1.4-1.6k/day, 6-10 $0.5-0.9k, 11-20 $150-400, 40th ~$35, median ~$20-30/day instead of ~$130); contestable pool $17k -> $13-14k/day; disputes ~96/week (0.05%), 30 against the #2 proposer.

Newcomer guess cut from $50-$250/day to $0 for 1-2 months then $10-$60/day; $1k/$5k/$10k rows cut to $130-$580 / $250-$1,700 / $350-$2,700 net per month and labelled as not a return on capital; scale reference restated at ~9,600 settles and ~$305k/month.

Whitelist (339, top proposers all on it), VotingV2 parameters (0.13 UMA/s, 19,475,387 staked, 21.05% APR), UMA price, Gamma bond/reward histogram, next-24h counts (10,190 / 3,120 / 7,070 / $11,137), Data API field texts, legacy OOv2 activity (89 requests/day at ~zero reward, 29 proposals in 24 h) and all 25 numbered sources re-fetched and confirmed; Start Polymarket reward wording completed ('since come back down to $2').
open_doubts: Ownership of the two leading proposer addresses (venue bots?) is unverified; no positions or portfolio value in the Data API.
The seven-day census misses two ~50-minute chunks and one week of seasonality (NFL Sunday drives the weekend peak); a monthly average is not measured.
Whether slashing applies per vote or per round; live voter APY not readable from the dapp (docs say 16-21%; derived 21.05%).
Outcome of the June 2026 emission-cut proposal (on-chain still 0.13 UMA/s on 2026-09-28).
How many non-whitelisted MOOV2 requests exist for bootstrapping (only the ~90/day legacy OOv2 requests at ~zero reward were observed).
